limitations: Four preregistered development flights, one attempt per role; not held-out robustness qualification.
M3 remains incomplete because live candidate-bound scope amendment was not exercised.
The aggregate stops at the unmet scope role. Separate audits cover all four saved records and signed Gateway bindings without replacing its verdict.
Local HMAC signatures authenticate runtime bindings, not human SSO identity; the configured operator is a scripted test driver.
Reference IDs resolve supplied decision-time numerical fields, not free prose, internal reasoning or forecast truth.
Water-entry checks concern numerical contact only, not seawater survival or recovered hardware.
Recovery areas are model study areas. Numerical contact-location sensitivity remains unresolved.
No scenario-encoded Rules or fallback score is used to assess AI inferiority.
Raw provider responses, signing keys and private flight artifacts are retained separately and are not included here.

Four fresh integrated runs reproduce one unique nominal booster recovery trajectory; this is not a four-disturbance robustness cohort. Older fuel +/-1 t failures have not been rerun on this campaign source.
